scope: One fixed supervised-scorer repair on exposed v107 development panels. No representation, split, role, source, vocabulary fitting rule, training frequency, smoothing denominator, or clustering change. No new manuscript input. No independent confirmation claim.

repair.baseline: Original sum over all six features log((count_class(f)+1)/(class_total+training_vocabulary_size+1)); equal class priors, lexical tie break, exactly reproduce saved predictions.
repair.new: Use the identical formula, counts and denominator, but sum only over features present in the pooled binary-role training vocabulary. A feature unseen in BOTH classes contributes zero to both scores. A feature present in the vocabulary but absent in ONE class retains ordinary add-one smoothing. No backoff, reweighting or broader context.
repair.tie: Absolute score difference <=1e-12 is unresolved: abstain in operational decisions; equal0.5/0.5 normalized score probabilities. No evidence gives exact0/0 scores and an abstention. Baseline retains its original literal tie convention.

comparison.all_panels: All eight original panels retained. Four prior adequately supported panels are primary development comparisons; four insufficient-support panels stay descriptive. Training gold roles supplied, so this remains supervised recovery, not role discovery.
comparison.recovery: Report balanced correct-credit on all test examples, assigning0.5 to a repaired tie (expected recovery under equal random tie decision). Also strict operational balanced recall counting abstentions as misses, coverage and role-specific abstentions. Never use accuracy among decided cases as headline. Separately report paired recovery on original evidence-bearing cases, so gains from abstention credit are distinguishable from recovery changes.
comparison.scores: Class-balanced log loss and Brier score of normalized old/new score probabilities, plus uniform0.5 reference. These are evaluation measures, not calibrated-probability claims.
comparison.uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-test-block bootstrap resamples per panel, no refitting.95% percentile intervals are descriptive on exposed data, not confirmatory. Equal-weight mean delta across the four prespecified supported panels, with paired independently drawn panel blocks. Degenerate missing-role bootstrap draws retained/recorded as undefined.
comparison.nulls: 199 context-column shuffles within each train/test block, train and test shuffled independently, refit same scorer and keep original gold.199 training-label shuffles within training block, original test labels untouched. Evaluate repaired scorer under each control. Fixed seeds1091000/1092000; all controls retained. Descriptive plus-one upper-tail null p across full balanced correct-credit, and Bonferroni8; no gate rescues or qualification promotion.
comparison.attribution: Save corrected errors, damaged correct predictions, abstention transitions and net per-role changes. No selecting favorable panel or abstention policy after scoring.

fixtures: All unknown features yield equal scores and abstention despite unequal class sizes.
Adding globally unknown features cannot change a repaired known-evidence margin.
Features absent in only one class remain evidence.
All in-vocabulary contexts give exactly the original score and decision except original exact ties become explicit abstentions.
Role renaming/class-size swap cannot create zero-evidence preference.
Order of features cannot change score beyond numerical tolerance.
limits: v107 is development data now. This comparison estimates the change on these exposed panels only; it does not establish fresh-source transfer, blind clustering, count selection or Voynich function recovery. A positive result needs a separately sealed independent confirmation before broader claims.
